attributes.name: contact info semantic markup
attributes.definition: Whether contact details are wrapped in a dedicated semantic HTML element such as address.

values.definition: Contact details are wrapped in a semantic address element.
Contact details use non-semantic containers such as div or p.
The page has no contact details.

attributes.name: contact info presentation format
attributes.definition: How contact details are displayed to the visitor: as raw text, as short link labels, or as a form.

values.definition: Contact details appear as short link text like 'Email us' instead of raw addresses or URLs.
Contact details appear as raw visible text such as an address, email or phone number.
Contact is offered through a form.
No contact details or contact mechanism are shown.

attributes.name: heading number treatment
attributes.definition: Whether numbers in long headings are kept in separate text elements from the heading words.

values.definition: Numbers in headings are placed in separate text from the heading words.
Numbers are part of the same heading text.
